message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.mirr.en: Mirror remembered! Now sneak and right-click the container it should send to
message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.mirr.zh: 已记下这面魔力镜！再潜行右键要送去的容器
魔力镜已链接到这个容器！

message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.othe.en: The remembered mirror is in another dimension
message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.othe.zh: 记下的魔力镜在另一个维度

message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.too_.en: Too far from the mirror (at most %s blocks)
message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.too_.zh: 离魔力镜太远了（最远 %s 格）

message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.mirr.zh: 记下的那面魔力镜已经不在了

message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.sour.en: The mirror takes items out of this container; link it to a different one
message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.sour.zh: 镜子就是从这个容器里取东西的，要链接到别的容器

message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.try_.en: Can't check that spot right now, try again in a moment
message.essentialcraft5.control_rod.try_.zh: 现在还查不了那里，稍后再试

tooltip.essentialcraft5.control_rod.usag.en: Right-click a Magical Mirror, then sneak-right-click a container within %s blocks of it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.control_rod.usag.zh: 右键一面魔力镜，再潜行右键离它 %s 格以内的容器

tooltip.essentialcraft5.control_rod.next.en: Sneak-right-click a container within %s blocks to link it; sneak-right-click the air to forget
tooltip.essentialcraft5.control_rod.next.zh: 潜行右键 %s 格以内的容器来链接；潜行右键空气就忘掉它

message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.u.en: Not linked yet: right-click it with a Control Rod
message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.u.zh: 还没有链接：先用控制棒右键它

message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.n.en: Linked to %s, %s, %s, but there is no container right below it
message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.n.zh: 链接到 %s, %s, %s，但它正下方没有容器

message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.t.en: Linked to %s, %s, %s, which is farther than %s blocks: not sending
message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.t.zh: 链接的 %s, %s, %s 超过了 %s 格，不送

message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.t.en: Linked to %s, %s, %s; waiting for that area to load
Linked to %s, %s, %s, but that is no longer a container
message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.t.zh: 链接到 %s, %s, %s，但那里已经不是容器了

message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.s.en: Linked to %s, %s, %s, but there is nothing it can take out of the container below
message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.s.zh: 链接到 %s, %s, %s，但下面的容器里没有能取出来的东西

message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.t.en: Linked to %s, %s, %s, but that container has no room for (or does not accept) anything in the container below
message.essentialcraft5.magical_mirror.t.zh: 链接到 %s, %s, %s，但那边放不下（或者不收）下面容器里的东西
